paragraphs: I am Leo, and I love clothes. Some of my clothes are very silly. Today Teacher Kim brings a big box to class. It has many clothes. "I want to teach you about clothes," she says. Four small boxes are on the desk. They say WATER, RAIN, COLD, and BIKE. "Put every thing in the right box," she says.

May takes a swimsuit and puts it in the WATER box. Mia takes a pair of boots and a yellow jacket. She puts them in the RAIN box. I take a long scarf. "This is cool," I say. I put it in the BIKE box. "Leo, a scarf is for a cold day," says Mia. "That is a mistake," says Teacher Kim. "Try again."

I look again. Now I put the scarf in the COLD box. A big coat goes in the COLD box too. May puts a blue helmet in the BIKE box. Then I find a funny pink swimsuit. I wear it on my head! "Is this a hat, Leo?" asks May. Everyone laughs. I laugh too. "No, it is for the water," I say. At home, I teach Mom the four boxes.
